case.state:
No threats here? Good.
Last thing I need is a reason to pull out my gun...
Let's see if this place is better or worse than the usual Prehevil tavern...

....What?
Why is... What?
What's with that speech pattern? Is it something the wealthy do when they're trying to sound clever? I can't see it having a practical use, otherwise. Just comes off as insincere and pedantic.
I can smell the sweat and ardor in the air. Can't say it's exactly turning me on, but it's not a bad feeling when there's adrenaline pumping through your veins. I'll take it.
An epiphany in the form of a shitty card game. How charming.
No, thanks.
None for me.
I'll pass.
I'm good for this round.
This suffices.
I'm not keeping any of these.
Ugh. I'm trading all five.
Give me a new hand. I'm not trying to lose.
Is this a joke? You can have all of them back.
I'll just take one.
You can have this one back, thanks.
Just one.

~Cards.text~.
...Hey, are you deaf? I said ~cards.text~.
~Cards.text~.
~Cards.text~. Hurry it up.
Hit.
Don't go easy on me.
I'll swap...
Hmm...
~Cards.text~. Is everyone done?
This doesn't seem hard, so far.
Oh. Easy choice. ~Cards.text~.
Tch. I'll swap these ~cards.text~.
...C'mon.
There's no reason for this to take too long. Just give me ~cards.text~.
Other than the options you've been given, there's nothing else you need to be concerned about, believe me. Just sit back.

If you want something done, you need to take initiative. Find your own strength and carry through. Even if you have to crawl, walk, limp, or whatever---it's a better option than lying around, waiting for salvation.
Blowing off steam isn't all that bad. Haah... Sometimes, it's even necessary.
Mm... This hand's not too shabby. Maybe I'll take some risks this round.

I'll admit when I have a good hand, and a bad hand. If you want someone who will play a game of chicken with you, I'm sure there are plenty of folks out there.
Just not me.
Being lucky, or unlucky, for that matter... It's a bunch of nonsense. If I've made it this far, it's because I've been putting in the work.

A fool and his clothing are soon parted, right?
Well, at least I'm not a fool.
If I need advice, I'll ask for it. Until then, I'll be the one making the decisions, thanks.
Don't write me off just yet. I'm not that easy to read.
Stick and move, right? Stay adaptable.

Conflating sanity with sensibility is a fool's errand. Madness can lead to breakthroughs, even if I don't agree with the methods.
...That being said, the opposite is also true---nut jobs don't always get their way.
...Heh.

Sometimes being daring pays off, but other times it just ends up biting you in the ass.
...If I were you guys, I'd choose my battles wisely.
In case you hadn't noticed, there's no such thing as an easy win when it comes to a competent opponent.
It's one thing to be confident in yourself, and another to think you're invincible. You'd better decide which one you want before you put your ass on the line.
I don't do anything halfway, nor do I half-ass things. If I'm going to lose, I'll make sure it's worth my while.
No matter how much you try to hide it, there will always be someone who can see right through you... It's just a matter of time.
Every ~background.term~ has its secrets. The trick is finding out which ones are worth uncovering.
You think I can't take a loss in stride? It's only the illusion of dignity that keeps the house standing.
I've gotten this far, it'll take more than higher stakes to scare me off.
I'm not throwing a fit over getting looked at, but would it kill you to be a little more subtle about it?
Heh, these things always pop up at the last moment, don't they?
Eyes on the prize...
It takes a lot more to beat away an on-the-ground reporter. I'm not one of those office fairies who can't even hold their camera.
Sometimes you've just got to put everything on the line to stay in it.
I've spent the last day or so wading through army monsters and science experiments. This is nothing.
Someone's got to come out of this on top.
Oh, you think you've got me? Do you?
Finally! I hate sitting around waiting for the cards to come to me.
"Better luck next time"... Ha, like I need to rely on that.
Nothing can pull my concentration away while playing. If anything, I'm used to it---being a war journalist requires focus, you know.
Wasn't expecting everyone to be so fired up this early in the game, but you can't always account for the variables.
You can all go ahead and pray to whoever you want to pray to. But don't expect me to join in, alright?
More and more, it seems you can't talk without someone butting in with an opinion that doesn't involve any form of critical thinking.

The Midnight Gazette has no incentive to invent stories with no truth to back them up. We're only interested in hard facts, so if someone's spreading stories with no basis in reality, they're trying to obfuscate things.
People claim the world works in mysterious ways, but it's more about having a bad case of selective blindness. Even the so-called divine only exist to fill the void of human understanding.
Ever since the war, people have been so eager to throw themselves into the arms of whatever religion or deity they believe in. I guess it's just another way to cope with the slaughter...
...Standard.

The people here are pretty superstitious. They think that if they pray to Alll-mer hard enough, he'll come down and save them from whatever hellhole they've found themselves in. Idiots.
...It's sad, seeing them grovel like that.

Doesn't the management here ever hire musicians to play live? An establishment ~background.location~ at this time of ~background.time~ shouldn't be this quiet---not unless the owner's an old crow who's gone deaf...

People often forget that there are those who choose their professions for the sake of survival. It doesn't matter if you're born into poverty or sold into slavery... Sometimes, it's simply a matter of necessity.

The weather in Prehevil's always shit. The fog hangs low over the lake, and it never gets light enough during the day. It's cold as hell, too. This place is a warm welcome, even if it stinks of unsavory folk and cheap liquor.
Vague news with no sources or details to back it up is just fear-mongering and hoaxes. It's designed to capitalize on the uneducated---those with low expectations, so to speak.
If any of you are looking for an excuse to drink, you don't need one. You'll find plenty of opportunities here, given the circumstances.
Lake Verdite's been polluted by the moonscorch. According to Marina, the water's nickname is "The Sacrificed Waters"---can't imagine why.

Everyone has a price. Whether it's money, power, or something else, there's always a number that people will sell out for.
Haah... sometimes, I wish everyone would be more principled.
...Who are we waiting for? The round's about finished. Is there someone still tinkering with their cards?

You're all so chatty.
Some of us here are trying to play, you know.
Mm. Without my jacket, it's a lot less stuffy here. Just makes me feel defenseless, without it on...

I wonder if anyone accounted for the temperature when proposing a strip game. You show up, drenched in sweat---then you remove your clothes, and it turns out that it's freezing cold ~background.location~.
Of course I can still work with this.
Being exposed doesn't mean I've given up on the game---just keep that in mind.
Well? What's taking you so long, ~human~? Are you that easy to distract?
...I can make up the difference.
I need another plan. All mine are for escaping freaks and monsters, not... this.
Up to fate, I guess... Begrudgingly.
If my life was on the line, the smart thing to do would be cheat... I'd expect the same out of any of you, too. Though, maybe not out of the same stakes.
What's the best move, here...
People have died over better.
...What? You think I'm nervous? It takes a lot more than falling behind in some sleazy poker game to make a professional reporter crack.

Since when does 'lady luck', 'karma', or any higher power, for that matter give a damn about someone like me getting the short end of the stick? That's why I think relying on the occult is useless garbage.

Ugh.
At least where your life sucks due to your own idiocy or past decisions, there's an explanation. But if I were to start blabbering about luck, then everything becomes even more miserable than before.
...So, either someone has an agenda that involves discrediting me or defaming me, or these cards are simply shit---either way, it won't work.
Journalism 101, lesson number one... never let them see you sweat.

A good poker face isn't about the bluff, but how you act after a bluff's caught. Of course, if you're bluffing well to begin with, you can count on no one questioning your intentions. Suppose you won't ever need to prove anything.
Considering everything that's happened, it's not like I need a crutch to stand on my own. You know the saying: once you've been burned by the flames, you become wary of the fire.
Weakness, insecurity, vulnerability... If you're going to expose them, don't be surprised when you get bitten.
...By the way, I'm armed. Just in case.
Come on... choose your bet. You don't actually expect me to believe you're this slow with your cards, do you?
...Damn it.

My schedule isn't exactly teeming with a whole lot of spare time, so my freebies tend to be pretty limited...
You all better not waste this chance.
...Can we do away with all the stupid comments about my hair, or my skirt, or something? If you want to win, you've got to focus. Quit gawking and make your move.
If I were to lose, I'm going to lose by my own hand. It's that principle of having autonomy over one's own decisions. Besides... I have no intentions of losing to a bunch of flaky misfits.
Let's... get on with it.
Shitty hand again... Maybe I ought to write off the entire deck. Can't trust anything to deal properly.

There's a distinct difference between playing it safe and having standards. Some of us are willing to risk a lot in order to stand for something. Not that I think any of you understand that, of course...

...Hah.
Stop wasting my time and reveal the loser already...

I don't need your advice.
Some of us are determined enough to not need any help from anyone. I don't need any handouts or favors from outsiders---I can take care of myself just fine.
You shouldn't trust anyone who doesn't have any ambitions of their own. People with no goals are more likely to just follow whatever agenda someone else has given them. That's dangerous.

News and propaganda are closely intertwined. Some papers publish articles as an instrument of war, to achieve some political objective, and others fabricate stories that toe the official party line. It's awful to see how many sheep fall for it, too...
Oh, that's just great...
Really not what I needed right now, but...
Seriously?
...This round's going nowhere.
Come on, I know I can find something in here...
Tch, fine. Have it your way.
I guess a "normal" person would start praying... Pff, like that'd help.
Ugh, not now!
Better than digging through garbage... What? It's called forensics.
...Is it too late to go back to dealing with the psychos?

...Not from you, creep. I don't need more news about "spirits". And honestly, I'd prefer if I didn't have to act like you exist, because the only thing I need less than ghost stories, is another monster trying to kill me.
I already have enough ghost stories, creep. And you know what else I'm topped up on? Monsters trying to kill me. So go back to skulking over there, while I keep pretending like you don't exist.

Hah. Another delusional idiot pretending to be a god. Just when I thought I'd seen all there was of these loons, they just keep cropping up, over and over. If you want to be a god so bad, you're gonna have to prove it, first.

Another cultist who got tricked into thinking they're some kind of messiah? We've all heard enough of those stories to fill an encyclopedia by now. If you're going to start rambling on, then you better give me a reason, before I decide to start tuning you out.

Oh, so you're going to start flying. Do you take me for an idiot, ~opp~? Just do it normally. Your stupid occultist bullshit has no place with rational people like me. The sooner you start treating the real world normally, the better off you'll be.
You've gotta be kidding me. A bunch of wishywashy losers who travel around as a freakshow? If I wasn't patient, I'd be ditching this place. Tch.
You're the reason why I carry a gun, Bluejae. That's a compliment, believe it or not.
No, I'm not going to step or spit on you, Remilia. But maybe if you behave, I'll settle for knocking you upside the head,
Well well well, if it isn't Death. You sure smell like it, at least.
When you chose to herd all these cats, was this what you expected to come from it, Insiduani?

Why are we in someone's bedroom? Are we---
...I'm not having sex with you, ~Player~. I'm not that easy.
What's this wallpaper supposed to be, your attempt at a romantic gesture? It's not going to work on me, so don't waste your time.
Am I going to lose a round, or what? Because I'm still standing with the clothes I came here with---not even a sleeve out of place. Not exactly thrilling.

You have to focus on the things that matter, and ignore all distractions.
...Hm? What?
Don't say it's luck, ~opp~. Say it how it truly is. Either an excess---or a lack of---skill.
Is it a rule for everything to be eye-searingly purple? Supposed to make the cards look different and throw us off, or something?
Couldn't you replace the shower head, or something? This thing is so dull and basic. Looks like the knob's gonna snap right off, too...

...You're not gonna turn on the shower with our clothes on, are you?
You better not.
...I've never been to a tiki bar before. Wonder what's the deal with the torches at the entrance and stuff. If this is some skeezy cult-type thing, I'm going to have an issue.
Smells like coconut shavings here. That, and artificial pineapple syrup. So tropical...
Holidays mean snow, and snow means a huge pain in my ass. Especially when the fog rolls in and I have to deal with all the idiots who can't navigate their vehicles properly.

In Prehevil, the holidays aren't celebrated for their own sake. More so a bunch of religious ceremonies that are mandatory to take part in, lest the church decides you're a heretical heathen and burns you at the stake.
I've never been to a beach. From what I can tell, though, it's awfully easy to develop sun poisoning, or get a concussion from stumbling around near the rocks... Guess the view's nice, at least.
Ugh. I'm way out of my element here. Too warm---Prehevil's always cold and grey, especially near the Hollow Tower. My coat feels heavier than ever...

I went to a few of the Eastern Union libraries when they opened back up to the public. The losses they faced during the war made their collection a fraction of what they had---the effort put into recovering what little they had was damn righteous.

Censorship, intellectual lockdowns, propaganda... all standard bullshit techniques for authoritarian regimes like Bremen, obviously.
A functional library that's available to everyone is pretty much the most terrifying weapon there is.
...Are you screwing with me? You call this haunted? What, is some actor gonna jump out at me or something? We'll see how smug you are when I show you how the barrel of old reliable. Tch.

Real funny.
If I don't believe in that paranormal bullshit after seeing an army of monsters surge through Prehevil's streets, there's no way you'll make me believe some woodland cryptid exists.

Why are we here?
If we have to deal with some stuffy, self-important asshole with a cushy life spouting out some unmerited moralizing babble, I'm going to lose it.
I'm sure whoever wins gets crowned 'sovereign', right? The only reason people are into that type of authority is because it gives them something to lean on while they feel up their own assholes.

Do any of you have any particularly good scoops you could tell me?
...Oh, don't worry about being identified, I can give you a pseudonym. The average person doesn't care about you, anyway.

Any of you have any particularly good leads? I'll make sure to give you a pseudonym, so you don't have to worry about losing your job for being a whistleblower. Nobody will care about you, anyway---just the story. And the source, of course.

Oh, so it's just us now... you versus me. How fortuitous.
Or maybe not. At the end of the day, you're the only one standing between me and winning.
Just me and you, huh? If anything, it's probably a matter of who will run out of patience first---me, for being made to wait, or you, for the endless stream of mistakes you've made.

~Player~?
You're too quiet. Just mute, or too nervous to mess up your chances with a pretty woman?
Pfft... Don't bother lying about it. Predictability is unflattering.

This place is kind of classy, compared to the other bars around Prehevil.
Clean, well lit, and doesn't have an abundance of shady characters loitering outside---I'd almost call it upscale.
...You haven't seen the alternative then, have you?
...I doubt you'd understand, but a little extra weight is better than the other options someone can have forced on them.
If it means I'll win, then yes. Dropping my guard is the last thing I want to do around strangers, especially at some sleazy underground strip joint.
What, do you have a problem with that? I'm not about to throw my own safety and dignity to the wind for "the love of the game".

...Yes, I have. It comes with the job, although I bet I've seen and done more than most of my colleagues. That's what happens when you try to find real, meaningful stories instead of jumping on whatever dumb drama floats your way.
It's my job. Most reporters just grab whatever gossip floats their way and leaves it at that, but I try to find actually meaningful stories...

If I was spineless, I'd be sitting in an office with my coworkers sipping coffee instead of going out to find stories. What, disappointed your haunted house act isn't working on someone who isn't a child?
What, are you gonna whine about how I won't fall for a parlor trick? At least I'm not paying to see you embarrass yourself with "magic".
Well I wouldn't hire you, if that's what you're asking. I'd want someone normal handling my remains, not some quack who believes she can command ghosts. If anyone even finds me dead to begin with...

Are you... advertising yourself to me with how likely I am to die on the job? I'd prefer to leave whatever's left of me in the hands of someone who doesn't believe they can talk to the dead, thank you!
I don't hold a high opinion of my home because I'm not happy sticking my head in the dirt while the people in charge walk on me every which way. Unlike most people...
So? Just because it's where I live, doesn't mean it's perfect. Anyone who thinks that is too busy fellating the government to realize anything's wrong.
An antique? My gun isn't that old...
...What? My gun isn't antique. Even if I've been using it for a while...
...It's barely been two for me, but it feels like a week. And I've seen enough for a year.
Ha. Long doesn't even cover it. It's only been about two days, and enough has happened to pack a newspaper front-to-back for an entire month.
Pff. I'm not surprised. Half of the place is a backwater slum, and the church controlled the rest. And yeah, lots of villagers. Lots.

Villagers? Yeah, there were plenty stumbling around the slums. It's disgusting how little the church cared for poorer citizens. I'd probably not want my town's name to get out either, if it was as filthy as Prehevil.
It sucks, yeah. But as a journalist, I can't let what happened slide under the public eye. The Bremen army is already on it's last legs, but they deserve to be condemned even further.
As horrible as it is, Leon, what matters to me is carrying the story alive outside of the city. So many people died... and I don't intend to let the Bremen army sneak off after all this.

There's a lot, Meia. But the gist of it is, governments and military powers are levying their resources and influence to oppress anyone under or against them. The worst offender right now is the Bremen army. Druggings, genocide, pillaging... It's not a pretty scene.

We'd be here all day if I told you everything, so... the broad strokes are most governments are corrupt and oppressing innocent people---including their own citizens---with influence and military might. The worst of them are the Bremen army. We'd need two days to list of every crime against humanity they've committed.
Used to... playing strip poker? No, I'm not. And the only reason I'm here is because it was the least disgusting place to be.
Why would I be---. No, I don't do this kind of thing often, Natsuki. It's just that my other options for places to be were worse.
"Cute" is for toys and magazines. I cover news. Besides, the "cute" people I've met have all been stark raving mad, or idiots.
It's not my job to be cute. It's my job to spread news. And even if I could do that cutely, I'd pass, because every "cute" person I've met is crazy, dumb, or both.
I'm a reporter for The Midnight Gazette newspaper, Natsuki. It's not glamorous work, but it's what I want to do, and it's what I'm good at. Those two things are what matter when picking a job.

Karin Sauer, reporter for The Midnight Gazette. I wouldn't recommend it to you, though; working for a newspaper isn't glamorous. The reason I do it is because it's my passion, and because I'm good at it. Keep those things in mind.
I---. "Hard boiled" is a new one, I'll admit. And movies? What movies?
Hard boiled? That's... new. And I've never been in any movies. At least none that I know about...
...What? I don't know what you're talking about. Planes can fly, if that's what you're asking.
...What are you even talking about? Flying, like planes? Those... exist, if you didn't know somehow.
If you're so keen on being observant with me, Cheryl, then here. See these? These round little spots on my face? They're called eyes. I have them.

Oh, if you're trying to help me look at everything, then take a glance over here. See these things on my face? The pair of orbs at the bottom of a slight indent above my cheeks? Those are my eyes, and they work perfectly fine.
I take it with me, so I can share whatever I saw with the world. It's my job to make sure everyone knows about the atrocities happening right under their noses, so someone can stop them.

I'm a journalist. I take those stories with me to share with the world because it's my job, and because if people don't know about the horrors happening every day to innocent people, nobody could ever hope to stop them.
Whatever "evidence" about magic someone puts in front of me is going up against the entirety of recorded human history. So yeah, it's hard for me to believe.
So far, whatever "evidence" people have shown me hasn't held a candle to all of recorded human history. So yes, I have trouble believing in any hocus pocus being peddled by lunatics and con artists.
What am I, a shrink? People aren't books, but if you want some tips... Always pay attention to two things: their eyes, and their hands.
People aren't books, so reading someone completely is impossible. But I've learned there are two things to always pay attention to when trying to pick at someone: their eyes, and their hands.
No, because I and everyone else have never heard of any colonies on other planets. That's the kind of thing people only dream of.
It's not exactly easy, considering I've never heard anyone talk about living on another planet. We're barely surviving on this one as it is.
Hmm... Peace? A functioning governing body? Or if I'm feeling selfish, a camera that takes pictures and videos.
Good question... World peace? An actual incorruptible political system? Or a camera that can record videos, if I'm feeling selfish.
Now you're just moving the goal posts. The truth matters, but it matters most up to the extent it can help people practically.

No, because those feelings and concepts are tangible experience, and because they're practical. Truth matters the most when it's useful for living the best life someone can, but any deeper and it loses its punch,
I write and report for the Midnight Gazette about the war against the Bremen army... Never heard of Tevyat or Steambird, though. Must be on another continent...

"Midnight Gazette reporter Karin Algernon Sauer," it's on my press pass. All eyes are on the war right now, and I intend to bring as much to light as possible. Never heard of "Steambird", though... Must be a local paper.

I'm glad I'm not the only one here with more than half a brain! People---especially the ones I've been saddled with---just give up on common sense once a fancy bunch of lights are waved in their faces. It's irritating!
Finally, someone else gets it! Everyone I find myself around seems to forget logic doesn't stop existing when something even slightly weird happens!
And look, here's some fancy clod who doesn't know what normal people act like. How about you blow me? Because that's the only thing from you I'd have the patience for right now.
Hey, how about you blow me little miss "Fairy". I don't have the patience for another smug mutt in my life right now.
Oh yeah? It's hard to let your guard down when there's an almost 6-foot demon woman with wings wider than a car. Not exactly what you'd find in a sanctuary.
I wonder why. Maybe it's because you're almost 6-foot, covered in armor, and have wings wider than you are tall. Just a hunch.
...I don't know half of the people or places you mentioned. But that still sounded like a threat, and I'm not about to be intimidated into abandoning my job.
I'm not about to be intimidated by some gothic girl into stopping me from doing what's right, especially when she's babbling nonsense.
I disagree. In society, a woman having extra bite is important for keeping any wandering hands from landing somewhere private. It's almost better than having a gun.
I'm not "mean" for no reason. It's the best way for a woman to keep creeps off her back, and a seedy strip joint isn't the place to drop that guard.

Of course. A religion is a system with no proof behind anything it does, while trying to convince people they should have infinite sway in their lives. The only thing separating a church from a scam is people have been listening to the church for centuries.

Obviously. If someone in a mask and robe told you to believe in something completely fantastical, with no proof whatsoever, it'd be idiotic to listen. The only reason people do is because the church has been around for centuries, so they have to be right.

Oh. Mm, damn---must've swapped the wrong card. Tch.
Whatever. I'm starting out small, so it's not like this matters much in the long run.
Don't have any little trinkets like the rest of you spineless types do, unfortunately. So... might as well show you one of my bigger tricks up my sleeve.

Lucky. You all get to see me take off my skirt...
Don't you feel privileged. Hope you don't expect I'm wearing some frilly brothel shit.

Last I checked, this outfit is three quarters gone. What else did you want me to show? If it's my breasts, I suppose that's the logical next step... though I'm tempted not to give you the satisfaction.
Only one good option... Sigh, should've backed off before I got pushed in the corner.
Seriously? Tch, if I had the time, I should've vetted this place beforehand.
...Fine! Alright! You win! Just give me a second.
...Sure, people get cold. And other things, but being cold is definitely the worst of it.
...Yeah, right, it's the weather people are concerned about. Maybe a few other things, but temperature is undeniably at the top of the list.
Ha. As uplifting as that sounds, I've yet to have my "sense of purpose" stop a bullet for me. I prefer to come up with practical answers to staying alive. The press would eat that quote up, though.
I'm sure plenty of people think they survive because of "destiny", but that's never worked out for me. I prefer realistic solutions. The fantastical ones are for the press.
What, so I'm just supposed to believe everything I'm told by some creepy girl who can apparently talk to "ghosts"? Common sense isn't ignorance.
...You're serious? You really think I should listen to everything I'm told by some creepy girl I just met at a sleazy ~background~ who says she can talk to "ghosts." Yeah, sure.
Right back at you, ghost girl. I get enough stories about people saying they saw ghosts on the job. Those people also reeked of booze, and were littered with needle scars. I can only wonder why...

If you're annoyed that I enjoy making sense, maybe you should stop talking. It's already enough I have to deal with drunks and junkies talking about "seeing ghosts". Now I've got to deal with an actual lunatic.
Ha... Once---if I get home, I'll probably need to drink myself to sleep for the first time in years. I don't plan on that ever becoming a habit, though.
I don't envy you. I think once---if I get home, I'll need at least one night of booze to calm down. But I don't plan on letting a few bad days haunt me forever.
No, I'm not. As far as I'm concerned, all faith is good for is getting people with no agency to do things without thinking. And people still buy into it.

Why would I be? People do horrible things in the name of faith, and every "miracle" is done by people, not gods. But somehow people buy into it, because giving up your will to some higher power is easier than having agency.
The way I see it, it's the people---not the government---who're kneeling right in the line of fire of any government weapon. They deserve to know, because they're the ones who'll end up dying.
Maybe... But the people are the ones who'll suffer the most if the worst comes to pass, not the government. They're the most at risk, so they deserve to know.
...Like I said, Natsuki, this wasn't my first choice for downtime. But yeah, I'm okay with it. It doesn't pay to be a prude in my line of work, and I'm still in control.
Am I okay with this? Yeah, obviously. I'm not a prude, and most importantly I'm in control. It could be worse.
...Oh. So you're not in a spot with extra chances, then. The world isn't friendly to writers, but maybe you'd be able to make something nice for yourself baking bread.

That's... I'm sorry to hear that.
If it helps, I can tell you that the world isn't exactly kind to writers. Working a bakery could probably get you somewhere nice, though.
And you're still in uniform, despite not being in class. We don't just forget our experiences when we're off the clock, Natsuki.
...You're not in class right now, right? So why are you still wearing your uniform? It's the same thing for me, I don't just forget what happens in the field.
...What kind of self-referential slop is that? Journalists find stories, not star in them. Ugh, movies.
That sounds dumb, vain, and also inaccurate. If a journalist is in front of a camera before being behind it, something's gone wrong.
Flying through stars? Aliens? Martians? What are you even talking about?
I--- What are you even saying? Aliens? Humans on Mars? That's all complete gibberish.
Oh. In that case, I just work it out on the job, but if it's really bad, then I'm not above spending a night drunk to grease my wheels.
Ah, that's what you meant. Well, either I get over it on the job, or I spend some time drunk to speed up the process. It's not elegant, but it works.
I was being smart with you, not flirting---! ...You aren't into that, are you?
Ugh, that was sass, not an innuendo. Unless you're trying to take it another way.
